snapshot.what_it_does: The provided pages do not describe the company's business activities; they contain only a stock-exchange filing and AGM notice for Dixon Technologies (India) Limited for FY 2025-26. What the company does is not stated in the material provided.
snapshot.geographies: Not stated. The company is registered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India (pages 1, 4), and has subsidiaries including Padget Electronics Private Limited, IsmartU India Private Limited, Kunshan Q Tech Microelectronics (India) Private Limited, Dixon Electro Appliances Private Limited, and Dixtel Infocom Private Limited (pages 5-8), but no geographic revenue breakdown is given.
key_facts: 33rd AGM scheduled for Monday, 28th September 2026 at 11:00 A.M. IST via VC/OAVM (page 1)
Proposed final dividend of Rs. 10 per equity share of face value Rs. 2 for FY 2025-26 (page 4)

Cost auditor (M/s. Satija & Associates) remuneration of Rs. 3,75,000 per annum plus taxes proposed for FY 2026-27 (page 5)
Re-appointment of Mr. Sunil Vachani as Whole-Time Director and Mr. Atul B. Lall as Managing Director proposed for 5-year terms from 5th May 2027 to 4th May 2032 (pages 9-10)

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Mixed credibility: segment financial targets (IT hardware, capex, Q1 FY27 volume rebound) were met, but core smartphone volume guidance was repeatedly missed and later revised down. FY26 volumes guided at 40-42M closed at 33M, Q4 guided 7-7.5M came in ~5.6-6M, Q Tech's INR2,000 cr/quarter run rate was far off, and telecom FY27 guidance was cut within one quarter.
